title: Loaded
description: The loaded mod adds a gun and things
body:
welcome to the world of LOADED, everything here can and will kill you.

![loaded](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/57d28f9037d0aa54af915b602f90470ad7371cd8_0.webp)

from killer cattle and farm animals, to villagers with pure hatred, this mod has it all, even an endgame! God armor and a weapon, but you will figure that out, through charms that give buffs, and once combined make great alloys that can be forged into god pieces and even a golem!

a new biome that is heavily guarden by angry villagers and said villager will have this mod's featured weapon, the pistol, you can grab the needed broken variant from either a low drop chance from the villagers of the biome, or the camp structures in it.

![the great muncher (he is back and better than ever)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7fd495bebbf3ead04dceb9d76445d9b506f3e425.png)
the muncher will eat anything it sees, mostly animals and certain items.
